response.sql: WITH rating_avg AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM rating_avg) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_ratio, r.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS above_mean FROM rating_avg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean ORDER BY r.rating;
